screens.candidate: gen-4 run 4 head (423836c7) served as pv-search W64/K8 + hybrid bury
screens.instrument: ten 520-cluster mirrored windows, 300 s cap, common MC-LCB control per window; DL random effects
screens.note: Sealed 13:58 ET. A matched-window, COMMON-OPPONENT contrast: each served policy is screened against the same MC-LCB opponents on the same seeds and the arms are differenced, so this is a summary-level estimate, NOT a direct duel and not paired served-vs-served inference. CROSSES ZERO (lower bound -0.002): no resolved difference between run 4's head and production's in served form, and equivalence is NOT established. I2 0%, tau 0, ties 49.7% vs 50.3%. Latency, as the MEAN OF THE TEN PER-WINDOW quantiles (vol_re.py averages window quantiles; it does not pool decision samples): candidate p50 0.10 s / p95 0.16 s, control 0.10 / 0.16. The five-window interim was +0.019 [-0.017, +0.055]. A rough power projection conditional on this effect and variance puts the lower bound near zero around 24 windows total, i.e. about 14 more (~6 h of Perf); that is a projection, not guaranteed resolution, and any extension is a new decision, not queued. Archive readouts/v34r5-run4-vs-r30/ with SHA256SUMS.

data.name: runPV3
data.status: Jerry 17:1x ET asked for 64,000 more clusters. Four 16k stores rather than one 64k run: a manifest is all-or-nothing on the seal, so four stores bound the blast radius and give resume granularity and one seed window each. Two guards, after Codex found the first version racy (#613): each store waits for its predecessor's DONE line, then takes an atomic mkdir lock held for the run. Cloud keeps runPV3 and runPV4.
